name: Southend-on-Sea

queries.query: Southend-on-Sea official council GIS map cadastral parcels property map
queries.result: Official Southend-on-Sea City Council results identified a council property asset map and an Essex public-body land and property map. The council page directs non-council-property questions to HM Land Registry. No public cadastral parcel feature response was obtained.

queries.query: Southend-on-Sea property asset map land registry map official council INSPIRE index polygons
queries.result: Independent first-party discovery found the same Southend council property asset map, the council planning/local-land-charges entry point, and HM Land Registry's England-and-Wales INSPIRE Index Polygons service. The national download page lists a Southend-on-Sea Borough Council GML file, but its current page redirected in a loop from the anonymous request and no file was downloaded.

registryBasis: Southend-on-Sea City Council publicly evidences a local property asset map and an Essex public-body land/property map. This is local map evidence, not proof that the council is a cadastral custodian or that the map contains all city parcels.

requests.outcome: Official council page fetched; links to Southend property asset map, Essex land and property map, and HM Land Registry. No parcel schema or geometry is embedded in the page.
Public ArcGIS Web App configuration page fetched. Anonymous app configuration was inspected for service routing only.
Anonymous app JSON returned a public FeatureServer reference at https://services3.arcgis.com/GHL0TW95ivGM736Z/arcgis/rest/services/EPAM200218/FeatureServer/0; source fields were not retained.
ArcGIS REST layer metadata returned Invalid URL; no schema, CRS, or geometry response obtained.
Bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry query returned Bad Request; no feature response obtained. This request failure is not evidence of citywide absence.

Anonymous curl followed 50 redirects and stopped with redirect-loop error; the official indexed page lists a Southend-on-Sea Borough Council GML download, but no download URL or geometry was verified.

Official HM Land Registry guidance confirms INSPIRE Index Polygons are indicative registered-property extents in England and Wales, published as GML with a Land Registry-INSPIRE ID. No Southend feature was retrieved.
